svg.title: Now Building — RangoNetwork
svg.desc: RangoNetwork, a CCNA v2.0 learning platform, built and operated on AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform with security checks in CI. The scene shows a commit passing CI checks, an image published to ECR through OIDC, a rollout to Kubernetes, and a learner request through Cloudflare Tunnel.
